summary: Iteration 137: Frontend theme and i18n testing for KARAU Meeting Portal. Tested purple/violet theme (karau-bg, karau-card, emerald accents), i18n translations, and P1 features. MAJOR BUG FOUND: SemanticSearchPage.jsx displays raw i18n keys (candidateSearch.* namespace missing 20 keys in en.json). Login, Dashboard, Settings, Recordings, Guest Join tab, KARAU AI Avatar all working correctly with proper theming and translations.
